notes.GM: German Greens' founding programme demands federal referendums and grassroots democracy (Basisdemokratie): -2.
notes.AP: The 1892 Omaha Platform of the People's Party demanded the initiative and referendum: -2.

trade.selfreliance.2.why: Economic nationalists, autarkic communists, fascists and self-reliance socialists back domestic production of vital goods whatever the cost; free-trade liberals and libertarians hold that comparative advantage and open markets are the better security; most traditions with no trade doctrine sit near zero.

notes.UJ: Nyerere's Arusha Declaration (1967) made self-reliance (kujitegemea) the national principle: 3.
notes.JU: Juche's chaju (independence) and jarip (self-sustenance) demand an economy that feeds and arms itself without foreign dependence: 3.
notes.HO: Hoxha's Albania forbade foreign credit and pursued full autarky after breaking with USSR and China: 3.
notes.NAZ: The 1936 Four Year Plan under Goering aimed at autarky in food, fuel and materials regardless of cost: 3.
notes.IS: Prebisch and CEPAL's import-substitution policy sought domestic production of manufactured and strategic goods behind tariffs: 3.
notes.HF: Hamilton's Report on Manufactures (1791) argued the US must produce arms, food and clothing at home for security even at a premium: 2.
notes.CL: Smith's Wealth of Nations (IV.ii) allows defence exceptions but otherwise argues against buying dearer at home what can be bought cheaper abroad: -2.
notes.LF: Cobden and Bastiat campaigned against the Corn Laws precisely over food protection: -2.
notes.NM: Small open Nordic economies depend on trade and rely on stockpiles and EU markets rather than costly autarky: 0.
